title_or_category: DAO: Dynamic Adaptive Offloading for Video Analytics (ACM MM 2022)
reason: Accuracy Estimator predicts server-DNN mAP per encoding configuration from the chunk key frame, including mAP=0 failure cases; bandwidth is a separate optimisation constraint, not an input; no video-only vs telemetry comparison. Content-based accuracy estimation is established.

title_or_category: Video Quality Monitoring for Remote Autonomous Vehicle Control (Kafetzis et al.; arXiv 2506.03166)
reason: Forecasts a VMAF-like perceptual score ~2 s ahead from packet loss, jitter, throughput and speed; predicts human-perceived quality, not AI reliability; no feature-set comparison.

title_or_category: TeleSim: A Network-Aware Testbed and Benchmark Dataset for Telerobotic Applications (arXiv 2507.04425)
reason: Network-tiered HIL teleoperation testbed (OMNeT++) with PSNR/SSIM and task performance; no downstream AI. Adds to occupancy of X10/X11.

title_or_category: LiteSC: Lightweight Semantic Communication for Robust Wireless Telesurgical Video Transmission (Deng et al.; arXiv 2609.23661)
reason: Same group as VISTA; AWGN channel 0-25 dB SNR on CholecSeg8k; reports PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS only; no downstream segmentation/phase evaluation and no telemetry-based prediction. Watch-list group.

title_or_category: ASTRA: Low-Overhead Runtime Architecture for STReam Adaptation in Video Analytics (arXiv 2609.07020)
reason: Network-dependent stream adaptation; uses detector confidence as a ground-truth-free accuracy proxy baseline. Supports V0-style confidence as an accuracy proxy; no failure-monitor comparison with telemetry.

title_or_category: Machine vision-aware quality metrics for compressed image and video assessment (arXiv 2411.06776)
reason: Quality metrics designed to predict detection/recognition performance on compressed video and reviews earlier no-reference/learned predictors of detector accuracy. Establishes the V1 (pixel-quality -> AI performance) idea generically.

title_or_category: No-reference image-quality model predicting object-detection accuracy on embedded cameras (NSF PAR 10123736)
reason: Bagged regression trees predict detection accuracy from observable image features. Generic V1-type precedent; bibliographic details to verify.

title_or_category: SwitchingNet: edge-assisted model switching under networking conditions (CCNC 2024)
reason: Selects among recognition models from full-reference image-quality metrics because compression under network limits degrades accuracy; network affects AI via pixels; no telemetry-based failure prediction. Authors to verify.

title_or_category: CooperScene: Multi-Modal Cooperative Autonomy Benchmark with C-V2X Communication Characterization (arXiv 2606.31219)
reason: Real C-V2X packet loss/latency measured and shown to degrade cooperative detection AP; argues for network-aware perception design. Network -> perception accuracy is established in V2X; no failure monitor.

title_or_category: Interruption-Aware Cooperative Perception for V2X Communication-Aided Autonomous Driving (arXiv 2304.11821)
reason: Robustness of cooperative perception to packet-drop interruption; mitigation method; not failure prediction.

title_or_category: TCSR-Monitor public code and headline results (MICCAI 2026 UNSURE)
reason: Released code; leave-one-corruption-out AUROC 0.814 vs 0.481 for predictive entropy. Confirms a strong, reusable video-only (V0+V1) baseline exists for segmentation; informs the V1 baseline design for phase recognition.

title_or_category: MICCAI 2026 surgical reliability titles: Knowing When to Defer (surgical VQA abstention, SafeSurg); Bayesian Temporal Pose Networks (uncertainty-calibrated tool pose tracking)
reason: Further occupancy of surgical abstention/calibration (X12/X15/X17); none involves network delivery or phase-recognition conformal sets.

title_or_category: Increasing Trustworthiness of Deep Neural Networks via Accuracy Monitoring (arXiv 2007.01472)
reason: Softmax-input monitor predicts per-sample correctness; generic V0-type failure-monitor precedent.

title_or_category: Knowledge-Guided Failure Prediction for object detectors (arXiv 2603.25499)
reason: Representation-based runtime failure prediction for detectors; generic failure-monitor occupancy; no network inputs.

title_or_category: Semantic-communication task-accuracy work (PSA-HARQ 2026; TONIC arXiv 2605.21553; prediction-aided semantic comm 2026)
reason: Channel/SNR prediction used to optimise transmission for task accuracy; receiver-side confidence gating in TONIC concerns token decoding, not AI-failure prediction. Adjacent to X20/X21.

reason: Reverse direction (AI uncertainty steers transport), like IX09; does not test telemetry as a predictor of AI failure.

title_or_category: HALO lossy-edge distributed LLM inference (arXiv 2601.11676)
